stage: decision_gap_v1: public candidate coverage and complete-denominator transfer events
fixed: Original V51 72 roots, V41 physical and working models, original start/deadline and MCT, same remote publication stream, original policy and rollout implementations. Original 88-state certificates remain in their own unchanged domain.
candidate_rule: Freeze original root-wide tail ride templates, excluding the incoming root ride. At original declared platforms add public continuous earlier boarding prefixes of those same trips, with pickup permission, preserving all original actions and exits and each platform's original remaining ride depth. Additions never become templates. Same-vehicle prefix length may exceed the former eight-leg limit. No actual label, gain, root identifier, probability threshold or scheduled-ready cutoff selects a candidate.
observation: Old-old uses original O; old-new and all new arms use the union of original and expanded station departure observations. All new arms have identical M and O. Existing remote trip set must remain unchanged. Original entry versus ready, simultaneous events, cancellation and horizon semantics remain unchanged.
randomness: Unchanged V51 stable full-graph trip tapes. Same state uses the same bank. CPU-unfinished rows retain original full loss bounds. No bank is a population certificate.
measurement: One cold-policy rotated pass. Query CPU includes model/history/node/observation/control setup, all decisions, logging and publication; V50 menu cost plus measured closure construction is added to each expanded-O query. Resident archive, per-day graph preparation, offline coverage audits, output IO and summary work are reported separately. Concurrent independent root jobs use process CPU as the primary compute comparison; elapsed wall time records shared-machine contention.
retention: All 72 roots and all ten arms, including failures, ties, negative results and missing actual labels. No rootwise hindsight-best baseline is deployed. New public panel unions all eight new-domain controls; legacy missing root15/cid127/28844 is a separate supplement.
events: Before reading actual event labels, register every original cheap root's first public onboard decision, each expanded upstream candidate and every declared downstream legal exit before absorption. Keep absent hub departures and unresolved probabilities. Compute root-frozen P0 joint trip laws; label actual endpoints separately. Reuse the corresponding new_full128 first-gate bank only for descriptive event contributions, without reexecuting policies or adding samples.

event_groups.downstream_opportunities: count on the declared same-trip path

gates: P1 and fixed-input P2 are authorized in this stage. Independent date calibration requires a genuinely unused date with endpoints and predecision messages; existing development dates cannot confirm. P3 independent paired challenger only if P1/P2 retain a relevant unexplained signal. P4 structural algorithm and P5 reconstruction require separate theoretical and novelty evidence. No unconditional 4096-world experiment or new full optimum solver.
